# Percona Community — llms-full.txt

> Curated snapshot for agents. This is not a dump of every page on the site. Use https://percona.community/llms.txt for the map, https://percona.community/sitemap.xml for inventory, and POST https://search.percona.community/search for discovery.

Source: https://percona.community/
Last updated for agent readiness improvements on the community Hugo site.

---

## What this site is

Percona Community (https://percona.community/) publishes community content for people who run databases in production: events, talks, speakers, blog posts, and contribution guides.

It is not the product documentation portal. Product docs live at https://docs.percona.com/.

---

## Agent entry points

- llms.txt: https://percona.community/llms.txt
- skill.md: https://percona.community/skill.md
- OpenAPI: https://percona.community/openapi.json
- AI Catalog: https://percona.community/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Developer docs: https://percona.community/developers.md
- Repo agent guide: https://github.com/percona/community/blob/main/AGENTS.md

Markdown mirrors: append `.md` to content URLs, e.g. https://percona.community/blog.md or https://percona.community/developers.md.

---

## Search API (public)

No API key for the public search surface.

Base URL: https://search.percona.community

### GET /health

```bash
curl -sS https://search.percona.community/health
```

### POST /search

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://search.percona.community/search \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"zero downtime database migration","limit":8,"content_type":"blog,talk"}'
```

Request fields:

- query (string, required)
- limit (int, default 20)
- content_type (optional): blog, percona_blog, event, talk, contributor
- min_score (optional float)
- per_type_limit (optional bool)

Results include url, title, content_type, excerpt, score, and optional author, date, tags, images.

Full schema: https://percona.community/openapi.json
Human docs: https://percona.community/developers.md

Admin/indexing UI on the same host may require HTTP Basic Auth and is out of scope for agents.
